Estimate the thermal-mismatch strain in an aluminum thin film bonded to an alumina (Al₂O₃) ceramic substrate when cooled by 180 K.
Use the biaxial thermal-mismatch strain formula: ε = (α_f − α_s) × ΔT.
Use the coefficient of thermal expansion of the aluminum film as α_f = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ (standard room-temperature value).
Use the coefficient of thermal expansion of the alumina substrate as α_s = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
Use the temperature change ΔT = 180 K, representing a cooling step.
Substitute the values: ε = (23×10⁻⁶ − 8×10⁻⁶) × 180 = 15×10⁻⁶ × 180.
Compute the resulting strain: ε ≈ 2.7×10⁻³.
Report the strain as tensile in the film, since aluminum contracts more than alumina during cooling and is constrained by the substrate.
State the final estimate: ε ≈ 2.7×10⁻³ (tensile).
